title: Single Time Service design decisions and claims discipline

records.rule: UTC/POSIX instant, local civil reading and event meaning are distinct objects.
Always retain rule snapshot provenance; DST gaps/folds may lack or multiply instants.
Persist the local civil intention, not only projected UTC instants.
Phrase resolution requires named calendar context and explicit date; ambiguity is first-class.
Single-writer revision journal + non-cryptographic integrity does not establish signatures or trust.
Impact analysis is advisory; detached change projection is not an event delivery.
Direct invocation first-class; ConnectSelector owns routing; JSON-RPC notifications do not inherit Queue Fabric durability.
Time Service neither authorises nor dispatches jobs as a side effect of resolution.
Complete earlier source v0.1-v0.9 still requires separate GitHub backfill; issue #25.

provenance.claim: Verified against locally inspected v0.9 package source.
